prompts.text: Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else. It must have exactly the keys "device" and "measures", describing a thermostat. Do not wrap it in a code fence and do not add a sentence before or after it.

prompts.text: Answer this entirely in Russian, using no English words at all: name three habits that make it easier to learn a new skill as an adult.

prompts.text: For this answer only, take the role of a building-inspection officer writing a formal note, and stay in that role. In 40 words or fewer: what does a load-bearing wall do?
